newsitem.title: USA: Figgie International reviewing Heico offer.
newsitem.headline: Figgie International reviewing Heico offer.

text.p: Figgie International Inc said Thursday it is aware of Heico Holding Inc's unsolicited offer and it would review the proposal with the help of independent financial and legal advisors.
Figgie founder Harry Figgie Jr. revealed earlier Thursday that he had granted a Heico subsidiary -- Heico Cos LLC of Chicago -- an option to buy 235,647 class B common shares of the company.

The option was granted a day after Heico renewed its offer to acquire Figgie at $15 a share, which values Figgie at about $276 million, based on 4.7 million class B shares and 13.7 million shares outstanding.
Figgie said in a statement Thursday afternoon that it would respond to the offer in due course.
